goal: Enforce the caller's maximum transaction weight when preset inputs fully fund a transaction
Prevents wallet RPC calls like fundrawtransaction from outputting transactions heavier than requested
reviewability: Nothing is known that would invalidate review now
agreement: Strong support with verification and no blocking objections
Verified that requested weight limits are enforced with preset inputs (jcastros, vicjuma, Zippo76)
Minor style suggestion to remove an unnecessary comment (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it resolves an edge-case parameter enforcement bug rather than a fund-safety issue
Ensures wallet RPC callers specifying transaction weight limits get their constraints respected
